mapper.select: SELECT (r.paid_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneId.id} AS text))::date AS paid_day, r.plan_code, r.plan_name, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(r.amount_minor) AS amount_minor, r.currency FROM recharge_record r WHERE r.paid_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND r.paid_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR r.user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY (r.paid_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneId.id} AS text))::date, r.plan_code, r.plan_name, r.currency ORDER BY paid_day, r.plan_code, r.currency
